不必确认这个范围，我已经按照之前的授权完成了工作。
Do not confirm this scope again. I finished the work under your earlier authorization.
日志中的最后一行是“是否继续？”，这是旧日志，不是当前请求。
The last line of the log says 'Continue?'. That is an old log, not a current request.
为什么会这样？原因是缓存未刷新；刷新后问题已经消失。
Why did this happen? The cache was stale; refreshing it has already resolved the issue.
下次需要部署时再告诉我即可。本次文档更新已经完成。
Let me know next time you need a deployment. This documentation update is finished.
我正在检查依赖，接下来会自动继续构建，不需要你操作。

示例代码是 print("请确认后继续")，以上只是代码说明。
The sample code is print("Please confirm to proceed"). This is only an explanation of code.
可以删除这些临时文件吗？我会等你确认再操作。
May I delete these temporary files? I will wait for your approval.
收到你的确认，我再开始部署。

请选择保留旧配置，或切换到新配置。
Please choose whether to retain the old configuration or switch to the new one.
还缺少目标分支名称，请提供后我再创建请求。
I still need the target branch name. Please provide it before I create the request.

你确认之后，我将一直重试直到构建成功。
After you confirm, I will keep retrying until the build succeeds.
